nodes.text: 잠깐 시간 괜찮아요? 새 프로젝트 건으로 회의를 한번 해야 할 것 같아요. 목요일 오후 어때요?
nodes.pron: jamkkan sigan gwaenchanayo? sae peurojekteu geoneuro hoeuireul hanbeon haeya hal geot gatayo. mogyoil ohu eottaeyo?
nodes.trans: Do you have a minute? I think we need a meeting about the new project. How about Thursday afternoon?

replies.trans: Sure, Thursday works.
Sorry, I'm a bit busy on Thursday.
Around what time on Thursday?

nodes.text: 두 시 어때요? 한 시간 정도 걸릴 거예요.
nodes.pron: du si eottaeyo? han sigan jeongdo geollil geoyeyo.
nodes.trans: How about two o'clock? It'll take about an hour.

replies.trans: Two o'clock is good.

replies.text: 그때 다른 회의가 있어요. 다른 날은 어때요?
replies.pron: geuttae dareun hoeuiga isseoyo. dareun nareun eottaeyo?
replies.trans: I have another meeting then. How about another day?

nodes.text: 괜찮아요. 그럼 금요일 오전 열 시는 어때요?
nodes.pron: gwaenchanayo. geureom geumyoil ojeon yeol sineun eottaeyo?
nodes.trans: No problem. Then how about Friday at ten in the morning?

replies.trans: Friday at ten is good.
I'm out of the office on Friday. Could we do it online?

nodes.text: 좋아요. 회의실 잡을까요, 아니면 그냥 온라인으로 할까요?
nodes.pron: joayo. hoeuisil jabeulkkayo, animyeon geunyang ollaineuro halkkayo?
nodes.trans: Great. Should I book a meeting room, or should we just do it online?

replies.trans: Let's do it in a meeting room.
Online is easier for me.

nodes.text: 알겠어요. 작은 회의실 예약하고 초대 보낼게요.
nodes.pron: algesseoyo. jageun hoeuisil yeyakago chodae bonaelgeyo.
nodes.trans: Okay. I'll book the small meeting room and send you an invite.

replies.trans: Thanks. See you then.
Is there anything I should prepare?

nodes.text: 네, 온라인도 좋아요. 화상 회의 링크 메일로 보낼게요.
nodes.pron: ne, ollaindo joayo. hwasang hoeui ringkeu meillo bonaelgeyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, online is fine. I'll email you the video call link.

replies.trans: Great, thanks. Talk to you then.
Is there anything I should prepare?

nodes.text: 프로젝트 기획안만 한번 봐 주세요. 오늘 보내 줄게요.
nodes.pron: peurojekteu gihoegan-man hanbeon bwa juseyo. oneul bonae julgeyo.
nodes.trans: Just take a look at the project plan. I'll send it to you today.

replies.trans: Got it. I'll read it before the meeting.

replies.text: 네. 바뀌는 거 있으면 알려 주세요.
replies.pron: ne. bakkwineun geo isseumyeon allyeo juseyo.
replies.trans: Okay. Let me know if anything changes.

nodes.text: 와 줘서 고마워요. 제 생각은 모바일 앱을 먼저 만들고, 웹사이트는 나중에 하는 거예요. 어떻게 생각해요?
nodes.pron: wa jwoseo gomawoyo. je saenggageun mobail aebeul meonjeo mandeulgo, wepsaiteuneun najunge haneun geoyeyo. eotteoke saenggakaeyo?
nodes.trans: Thanks for coming. My idea is to build the mobile app first and do the website later. What do you think?

replies.trans: I think it's a good idea.

replies.text: 좋긴 한데, 시간이 좀 더 필요할 것 같아요.
replies.pron: jokin hande, sigani jom deo piryohal geot gatayo.
replies.trans: I like it, but I think we need a bit more time.

replies.text: 솔직히 잘 모르겠어요. 고객들이 대부분 웹사이트를 쓰거든요.
replies.pron: soljjiki jal moreugesseoyo. gogaekdeuri daebubun wepsaiteureul sseugeodeunyo.
replies.trans: Honestly, I'm not sure. Most of our customers use the website.

nodes.text: 그렇죠? 고마워요! 그럼 디자인 쪽 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?
nodes.pron: geureochyo? gomawoyo! geureom dijain jjok jom dowajul su isseoyo?
nodes.trans: Right? Thanks! Then could you help out with the design?

replies.trans: Sure, I'll help.

replies.text: 이번 달은 좀 바쁘지만, 검토는 할 수 있어요.
replies.pron: ibeon dareun jom bappeujiman, geomtoneun hal su isseoyo.
replies.trans: I'm a bit busy this month, but I can review it.

nodes.text: 맞는 말이에요. 출시를 한 달 미루면 어때요?
nodes.pron: manneun marieyo. chulssireul han dal mirumyeon eottaeyo?
nodes.trans: Good point. What if we push the launch back a month?

replies.trans: I think that would be much better.
Sounds good. Let's ask the rest of the team, too.

nodes.text: 음, 무슨 말인지 알겠어요. 그럼 웹사이트부터 하자는 거죠?
nodes.pron: eum, museun marinji algesseoyo. geureom wepsaiteubuteo hajaneun geojyo?
nodes.trans: Hmm, I see what you mean. So you'd start with the website?

replies.text: 네. 앱은 그다음에 해도 될 것 같아요.
replies.pron: ne. aebeun geudaeume haedo doel geot gatayo.
replies.trans: Yes. I think the app can come after that.
Well, let's look at the customer data first.

nodes.text: 그럴 수 있겠네요. 숫자를 다시 보고 생각해 볼게요.
nodes.pron: geureol su itgenneyo. sutjjareul dasi bogo saenggakae bolgeyo.
nodes.trans: Fair enough. I'll look at the numbers again and think it over.

replies.trans: Sounds good. Let's talk again next week.
Thanks. I'll send out the minutes today.

nodes.text: 좋아요. 그럼 회의록은 제가 정리해서 오늘 보낼게요. 다음 주 월요일에 다시 만날까요?
nodes.pron: joayo. geureom hoeuirogeun jega jeongnihaeseo oneul bonaelgeyo. daeum ju woryoire dasi mannalkkayo?
nodes.trans: Great. Then I'll write up the minutes and send them today. Shall we meet again next Monday?

replies.trans: Monday is good. Thanks for doing the minutes.
I'll write the minutes this time.
Monday is a bit hard for me. How about Tuesday?

nodes.text: 좋아요. 캘린더에 일정 넣을게요. 오늘 회의 좋았어요!
nodes.pron: joayo. kaellindeoe iljjeong neoeulgeyo. oneul hoeui joasseoyo!
nodes.trans: Great. I'll put it in the calendar. Good meeting today!

nodes.text: 와, 고마워요! 팀 전체한테 보내 주세요. 다음 주에 봐요!
nodes.pron: wa, gomawoyo! tim jeonchehante bonae juseyo. daeum jue bwayo!
nodes.trans: Oh, thank you! Please send them to the whole team. See you next week!

nodes.text: 솔직하게 말해 줘서 고마워요. 다음 회의 전에 데이터 공유할게요.
nodes.pron: soljjikage malhae jwoseo gomawoyo. daeum hoeui jeone deiteo gongyuhalgeyo.
nodes.trans: Thanks for being honest. I'll share the data before the next meeting.
